en_title: The Elder Scrolls 6 Is Reportedly Subtitled 'Sentinel,' New Story Details Revealed Ahead of Rumored Announcement
subtitle: 落锤省的秘密
opus_summary: 据The Verge报道，《上古卷轴6》副标题为Sentinel，名称最快可能下月公布。游戏据称设定在落锤省，玩家将首次亲自探索上古卷轴的历史与秘密。

paragraphs.en: A new report claims the next Elder Scrolls game will be titled The Elder Scrolls 6: Sentinel , along with new story details.
paragraphs.cn: 一篇新报道声称，下一部《上古卷轴》游戏将定名为《上古卷轴6：Sentinel》，并披露了新的剧情细节。

paragraphs.en: According to The Verge , The Elder Scrolls 6: Sentinel is the title of the highly-anticipated follow-up to Bethesda's Skyrim. This title has been rumored for some time now , but The Verge is putting extra weight behind it. According to the outlet, the game's title could be formally announced as soon as next month, possibly aligned with either Skyrim's 15th anniversary or Xbox's 25th anniversary. The game will reportedly take place in Hammerfell and dive into the history of the titular artifacts, allowing players to discover their secrets firsthand for the first time.
paragraphs.cn: 据The Verge报道，贝塞斯达备受期待的《上古卷轴5：天际》续作将定名为《上古卷轴6：Sentinel》。这个名称已经传闻了一段时间，而The Verge的报道又为其增添了可信度。该媒体称，游戏名称最快可能在下个月正式公布，或许会配合《上古卷轴5：天际》15周年或XBOX25周年纪念。游戏据称将以落锤省为舞台，深入探索标题所指的神器——上古卷轴的历史，让玩家首次亲自揭开它们的秘密。

paragraphs.en: All of this is pretty exciting and shows that the game is likely getting closer to release. While we're not quite sure when to expect The Elder Scrolls 6, it wouldn't be surprising if we hear more details next year ahead of a 2028 release. However, Bethesda does like to wait until its games are close to the finish line to really lay it all out there, so we may be waiting a while before we get raw gameplay.
paragraphs.cn: 这些消息都相当令人兴奋，也表明游戏很可能正逐渐接近发售。虽然我们还不太确定何时能玩到《上古卷轴6》，但如果明年公布更多细节、随后在2028年发售，也并不意外。不过，贝塞斯达确实喜欢等游戏接近完成时才全面展示，因此我们可能还得等上一段时间，才能看到实机演示。

paragraphs.en: The road to The Elder Scrolls 6 has been quite long, as Bethesda announced the game back in 2018. At that stage, the game was still in the very, very early stages of pre-production. It may not have even really been anything more than a concept at that point, since Bethesda was full steam ahead on Starfield, which wouldn't release for another five years from that point. Since shipping Starfield, The Elder Scrolls 6 has become a massive priority and the studio's focus going forward.
paragraphs.cn: 《上古卷轴6》一路走来已相当漫长，贝塞斯达早在2018年就公布了这款游戏。当时，游戏还处于前期筹备极其早期的阶段，甚至可能仅仅是个概念，因为贝塞斯达正全力开发《星空》，而后者又过了五年才发售。自《星空》发售后，《上古卷轴6》便成为工作室优先级极高的项目，也是其接下来的工作重心。

paragraphs.en: Although there is a lot happening in and around Bethesda with future Fallout games, re-releases, and Starfield updates, The Elder Scrolls 6 seems to be taking the bulk of the developer's focus. The only question now is: will it all be worth the long wait?
paragraphs.cn: 虽然贝塞斯达及相关团队还有不少工作要忙，包括未来的《辐射》游戏、重新发行的作品以及《星空》更新，但《上古卷轴6》似乎仍占据了这家开发商的大部分精力。现在唯一的问题是：它能否让这场漫长的等待变得值得？
